projects.title: LLM Replay
projects.description: A transparent HTTP proxy that captures AI agent sessions across Ollama, OpenAI, and Anthropic with no SDK or code changes. Records requests, tool calls, streaming chunks, and token usage. Includes live WebSocket inspection, automatic issue detection (loops, ignored errors, token waste), session replay without LLM calls, and branching to edit any step and rerun from that point.

projects.title: CineLens
projects.description: Upload a movie frame, identify actors via InsightFace embeddings with pgvector similarity search against TMDB cast data (74-95% confidence), detect objects with YOLOv8, and run scene analysis through a local vision LLM. Redis job queue isolates ML inference from the API, SSE streams 9 live progress stages to the browser, and results are cached with SHA-256 keys for instant repeat lookups.
